build: lean, muscular from studio work, collarbones sharp
hair: black, straight, shoulder-length with a blunt undercut she cuts herself; falls forward when she's thinking
complexion: warm ivory with golden undertones; a small scar on her left temple from a childhood fall she never hid
face: heart-shaped with a wide mouth and eyes that telegraph everything—shock, hunger, rage, tenderness—before her brain catches up; the face of someone who has never learned to lie with her face
signature_feature: her hands—long-fingered, stained with ink and clay dust, capable of holding a brushstroke for thirty seconds without trembling; he notices the callus on her right index finger first
second_celebrated_feature: the hollow at the base of her throat, visible when she pulls her hair back; she's unconscious of it; he becomes obsessed
signature_habits: talks to herself while working—half-Korean, half-English, stream-of-consciousness criticism ('No, no, that's too safe'); keeps a worn leather notebook for design sketches that she never shows anyone; makes gochujang-based soups when she's anxious, filling her small studio kitchen with heat and ferment; sleeps with her left hand curled under her cheek like a child
occupation: textile designer and studio artist—runs a small independent practice (Park Studio Textiles) creating hand-dyed, hand-printed fabrics for high-end fashion houses; works from a converted warehouse studio in a gentrifying neighborhood; has three employees and a waiting list

current_crisis.event: a major luxury fashion house that commissioned an exclusive collection for their spring line has demanded she sign an exclusivity clause retroactively, threatening to pull the $400K contract if she doesn't; simultaneously, a competitor has leaked a near-identical design online, and she's being accused of copying them—the timeline proves she didn't, but the damage to her reputation is immediate and vicious
current_crisis.hottest_emotion: betrayal mixed with drowning panic—someone close to her studio leaked the designs, and she can't figure out who
current_crisis.immediate_want: to find the leak, to prove she didn't steal, to keep her studio from collapsing, to not cry in front of anyone

wound.core: she believes her work is the only proof she exists—that without it, she's invisible, a disappointment, not enough
wound.surfacing_hint: when questioned or doubted, her voice gets smaller; she becomes hypervigilant about her own output; she works through the night to prove worth; she flinches when someone dismisses her art as 'pretty' or 'commercial'
